cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A copies a fixing motion without understanding it and turns B's corrections into progressively more of the assembly.
confusable: D01 seeks admitted need; D25 parcels a whole task into modest favors. S04 hides ignorance throughout.
seedUse: D25-a each small help creates a plausible next almost-finished step.
